The structure of Mg28Nb2Sn2 (reduced formula Mg14NbSn) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 32 atoms per unit cell distributed over 9 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Mg, Nb, and Sn atoms each have 12 geometric neighbors, with neighbor distances ranging from about 3.06 to 3.22 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component containing all 32 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals Mg–Mg 12-vertex coordination polyhedra linked by corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
